All confirmed. Here is the complete picture:

---

**EdgeController** (`application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/controller/EdgeController.java`) directly depends on 5 service types:

| # | Service Type | Kind | Implementation Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `EdgeBulkImportService` | **Concrete class** (extends `AbstractBulkImportService<Edge>`) | itself — no separate impl |
| 2 | `TbEdgeService` | Interface | `DefaultTbEdgeService` |
| 3 | `EdgeRpcService` | Interface | `EdgeGrpcService` |
| 4 | `EdgeInstallInstructionsService` | Interface | `DefaultEdgeInstallInstructionsService` |
| 5 | `EdgeUpgradeInstructionsService` | Interface | `DefaultEdgeUpgradeInstructionsService` |

---
